content.json:
## Reckoner pipeline

Built from the job's structured logs (`ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL`, one JSON event per line). Every query here is also a file in `deploy/workbook/` and can be run on its own. Log Analytics keeps 31 days.

### Run history

One row per attempt. **killed (no job_end)** is the out-of-memory signature: the container is stopped before Python can log anything. An execution's status in the portal can read *Running* while its attempts here have already failed, because replicas retry.

content.query:
// One row per attempt. A replica that logged job_start and never job_end was
// killed -- the container's OOM signature, which leaves no exception to log.
let events = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerJobName_s startswith "reckoner-"
| extend e = parse_json(Log_s)
| where isnotempty(e.event)
| extend attempt = ContainerGroupName_s,
         execution = replace_regex(ContainerGroupName_s, @"-[a-z0-9]+$", "");
events
| summarize started = minif(TimeGenerated, tostring(e.event) == "job_start"),
            ended = maxif(TimeGenerated, tostring(e.event) == "job_end"),
            exit_code = take_anyif(toint(e.exit_code), tostring(e.event) == "job_end"),
            stage = take_anyif(tostring(e.stage), tostring(e.event) == "job_start"),
            system = take_anyif(tostring(e.system), tostring(e.event) == "mart_selection"),
            build = take_anyif(substring(tostring(e.build_sha), 0, 7), tostring(e.event) == "job_start"),
            peak_rss_mib = max(toint(e.peak_rss_mib)),
            ceiling_mib = take_anyif(toint(e.memory_ceiling_mib), tostring(e.event) == "preflight")
  by job = ContainerJobName_s, execution, attempt
| where isnotnull(started)
| extend outcome = case(isnull(ended), "killed (no job_end)", exit_code == 0, "succeeded", strcat("failed, exit ", tostring(exit_code))),
         minutes = round(datetime_diff("second", coalesce(ended, now()), started) / 60.0, 1),
         headroom_mib = ceiling_mib - peak_rss_mib
| project started, job, execution, attempt, stage, system, outcome, minutes, peak_rss_mib, ceiling_mib, headroom_mib, build
| order by started desc
content.title: Run history

content.json:
### Duration per stage

Completed stages only. A killed stage has no `stage_end` and appears in the run history instead, not here.

content.query:
// Wall-clock per completed stage. A killed stage has no stage_end and is
// absent here by design; it appears in the run history as killed.
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerJobName_s startswith "reckoner-"
| extend e = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(e.event) == "stage_end"
| project TimeGenerated, stage = tostring(e.stage), seconds = todouble(e.seconds), exit_code = toint(e.exit_code)
| summarize runs = count(), median_s = percentile(seconds, 50), max_s = max(seconds), failures = countif(exit_code != 0) by stage
| order by stage asc
content.title: Duration per stage

content.json:
### Peak memory against the ceiling

The process peak never falls, so it cannot say where memory went. The worst per-slice window names the slice.

content.query:
// Peak resident memory per attempt against the container ceiling, and the
// slice with the worst window. The process peak never falls, so on its own it
// cannot name where memory went; the per-slice window can.
let events = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerJobName_s startswith "reckoner-"
| extend e = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend ev = tostring(e.event);
let worst = events
| where ev == "mart_shard"
| summarize arg_max(toint(e.rss_window_peak_mib), shard = tostring(e.shard)) by attempt = ContainerGroupName_s
| project attempt, worst_slice = shard, worst_slice_window_mib = e_rss_window_peak_mib;
events
| where ev in ("preflight", "mart_shard", "stage_end", "memwatch_peak")
| summarize started = min(TimeGenerated),
            ceiling_mib = take_anyif(toint(e.memory_ceiling_mib), ev == "preflight"),
            process_peak_mib = max(toint(coalesce(e.peak_rss_mib, e.sampled_peak_rss_mib)))
  by attempt = ContainerGroupName_s, job = ContainerJobName_s
| join kind=leftouter worst on attempt
| extend used_pct = round(100.0 * process_peak_mib / ceiling_mib, 1)
| project started, job, attempt, ceiling_mib, process_peak_mib, used_pct, worst_slice_window_mib, worst_slice
| order by started desc
content.title: Peak memory against the ceiling

content.json:
### Manifest match per layer

Stage 1's verdict per layer per run. A layer present in one run and absent from the next means the run checked fewer layers.

content.query:
// Stage 1's verdict per layer per run. A layer checked in one run and absent
// in the next is itself a finding: the run checked fewer layers than before.
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerJobName_s startswith "reckoner-"
| extend e = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(e.event) == "manifest_summary"
| project TimeGenerated, run = ContainerGroupName_s, layer = tostring(e.layer),
          matches = tobool(e.matches),
          expected_rows = tolong(e.expected_rows), observed_rows = tolong(e.observed_rows),
          expected_files = toint(e.expected_files), observed_files = toint(e.observed_files)
| extend row_drift = observed_rows - expected_rows
| order by TimeGenerated desc, layer asc
content.title: Manifest match per layer
